name: Explorium
description: Explorium provides real-time, structured B2B data infrastructure for AI agents, copilots and GTM automations: company and prospect search, enrichment, and business event signals over a unified REST API and a hosted MCP server.

skills.name: company-search
skills.title: Company search
skills.description: Find companies matching firmographic, technographic, location, size, revenue and intent filters.

skills.name: company-enrichment
skills.title: Company enrichment
skills.description: Enrich a known company with firmographics, technographics, funding, financials and workforce trends.

skills.name: company-matching
skills.title: Company matching
skills.description: Resolve a company name or domain to a stable Explorium business identifier.

skills.name: prospect-search
skills.title: Prospect search
skills.description: Find people by role, seniority, department, skills and employer attributes.

skills.name: prospect-enrichment
skills.title: Prospect enrichment
skills.description: Enrich a matched person with professional profile and contact details.

skills.name: business-events
skills.title: Business event signals
skills.description: Read events such as funding rounds, hiring and headcount changes, new products, office moves and acquisitions.

skills.name: mcp-access
skills.title: MCP server access
skills.description: Use the same capabilities as native tools from any MCP-compatible agent over Streamable HTTP.
